mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts below 1150.0 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1150.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past three months indicates robust supply chain activity and corporate capacity utilization, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1150.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1150.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.1% from the prior month signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.1% from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
